strategies.name: Naive Sequential 8-Stage All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Directly follows the reference implementation with 8 sequential all_reduce calls, each preceded by bidiagonal coupling and followed by decoupling operations on the full W*S tensor. Total 8 all_reduce dispatches with full tensor payload each time. Represents the baseline: simplest correctness, no optimization, maximum latency from sequential barriers.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Per Stage
strategies.desc: Replace each all_reduce with reduce_scatter (producing S-sized local shard) followed by all_gather to reconstruct the full tensor. This yields 16 collective dispatches (2 per stage × 8 stages) but with smaller average payload per collective (reduce_scatter sends W×S/W, all_gather receives same). Trades dispatch count for reduced per-rank communication volume and potential bandwidth optimization.

strategies.name: Fused Bidiagonal Computation with Vectorized All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Precompute all 8 coupled tensors in local memory as a stacked (8, W*S) tensor, then issue a single batched or loop-unrolled sequence of 8 all_reduce operations with minimal CPU round-trips by eliminating intermediate decoupling steps where algebraically redundant. Total 8 dispatches but with overlapped kernel launches and better cache locality from contiguous buffer layout.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction (Intra-Node + Inter-Node)
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by performing intra-node all_reduce (or reduce+broadcast within each node's devices) followed by inter-node all_reduce on representative ranks, then broadcast back. For 8 stages this yields ~24 dispatches (3 collectives × 8) but leverages faster intra-node interconnect (NVLink/local fabric) for bulk of data movement, reducing cross-node traffic.

strategies.name: Pipelined Ring All-Reduce with Chunk Overlap
strategies.desc:
Decompose each W*S tensor into C chunks and manually implement ring all_reduce for each stage, allowing chunk-level pipelining where chunk k+1 begins transmission while chunk k is still in flight. Total ~8×W dispatch pairs (send/recv per rank per stage) but enables latency hiding through pipeline parallelism and avoids global synchronization barriers of collective all_reduce.
